scope: Read-only implementation and limited one-route diagnostic review; no final sidecar acceptance or solver/test execution.
findings: Required reaction is incoming-minus-outgoing unit tangent: the negative of local unit-tension resultant. The chain Jacobian uses the correct positive diagonal/negative adjacent Hessian blocks (I - tangent outer product)/segment length. Solving J delta = -actual-facet residual has the correct sign.

Only free nodes receive corrections. Each iteration performs whole-solid clearance and fresh local nonnegative material-facet reaction/cone fitting. Missing support and collision errors without an attached reaction report propagate.

Native-plane optimization always releases its coordinate constraint before the full 3D settling/certification phase. Zero correction is permitted when existing fresh 3D gates already pass; this is not proof of an additional global shortest-path search.

The final rounded-cache source still independently checks actual facet reactions, finite guide span, bore approach/inset, full radius solid/tube clearance and length. These final candidate gates have not yet been supplied.

policyObservations.name: per-correction-search-bound
policyObservations.detail: At most five corrections, each at most 10 micrometres; that is not a cumulative 10 micrometre bound. Report actual displacement/iteration counts without calling it a new physical tolerance.

policyObservations.name: weighted-normal-error-bound
policyObservations.detail: The reviewed facet_reconstructed_balance reports weightedMaterialConeErrorBounds but its pass status gates only actual nodal residual. Fresh independent all-16 review will require both actual nodal residual and the maximum weighted cone-error bound <= unchanged 1e-5.

policyObservations.name: search-vertex-budget
policyObservations.detail: The reviewed _optimize_lead tries dense material settling before its 128-vertex guard. The guard should cover that branch too; no resource budget pass is claimed by this review.
